fixes: The source_lines and labels rows carry only `diagnostic`, so within diagnostic 1 the snippet of the error (lines 3-8), of the `note` (lines 13-16) and of the `help` (lines 19-20) cannot be told apart. Source line 4 appears twice: once from line 5 and once from the help's suggestion on line 19. Give every header line matched by H (lines 0, 10, 17, 22, 32) a sub-diagnostic index. Add it as a column (e.g. `part`, plus its `level`) to the diagnostics, source_lines and labels tables, filled from the most recent H header above each row.

Labels are printed under the numbered source line they annotate (lines 4, 6, 8 annotate source lines 3, 4, 5; line 14 annotates source line 1; lines 26, 28, 30 annotate 7, 8, 9; line 36 annotates 10), but the labels table drops that parent. Add a `line` column to labels, filled from the last numbered gutter line (the G match with `num`) above it.

Line 14 holds two separate labels. The first is marker `----`, whose text `in this function` is printed on line 16, joined to it by the `|` connector on line 15. The second is marker `^^^^^^^^` with text `this parameter takes ownership of the value`. The M regex reads only the first marker run, so it records marker `----` with label `^^^^^^^^ this parameter ...`, and it emits lines 15 and 16 as two more junk rows (marker `|` with an empty label, and an empty marker with `in this function`). Split a gutter line into each run of `-^+~` characters with its trailing text. Attach the text found below a `|` connector at the same column to the marker in that column. Do not emit `|`-only connector lines as rows.
